### 对应案例或页面 / Related case or page

请提供链接或记录编号。 / Provide a link or record identifier.

### 公开原始来源 / Public original source

网址、原语言标题、作者或机构、发布日期（如可确认）。
URL, original-language title, author or institution, and publication date if known.

### 具体建议 / Specific suggestion

请区分来源陈述与你的解释；如涉及翻译，请提供原文及建议译法。
Distinguish the source’s statement from your interpretation. For translations, include the original wording and suggested translation.

### 补充说明 / Additional context

Issues 是公开的，请勿提交私人通信、个人敏感信息或未获准公开的草稿；无需上传第三方全文。
Issues are public. Do not submit private correspondence, sensitive personal information or unpublished drafts without permission. Third-party full texts are not required.
